LanguageData.VTU_RestartNote: Turn each fix or tweak on or off. Changes take effect after restarting the game.
LanguageData.VTU_RestartRequired: Restart the game to apply this change.
LanguageData.VTU_Failed: Could not be applied (see the log); this module is off for this session.
LanguageData.VTU_ProvidedByLegacy: (skipped: already provided by the standalone mod "{0}")
LanguageData.VTU_FactionLeader_Desc: Fixes the "Faction leader for X is null" error by generating a new leader the way vanilla does when a leader dies.
LanguageData.VTU_HistoryGraph_Desc: Removes the History tab lag in long-running colonies. The graph looks the same; peaks and dips stay visible.
LanguageData.VTU_RightClickMenu_Desc: Stops the stutter while a right-click menu is open on the map. Options are re-checked every 5 seconds instead of every 4th frame, and still on click.
LanguageData.VTU_TradeDeal_Desc: Removes the long freeze when a trade window opens in a colony with many items. With Auto Seller, its trades no longer rebuild the trade list a second time.
LanguageData.VTU_SiegeBuilder_Desc: Fixes the error spam when a sieging group contains mechs (added by other mods): pawns without skills defend the camp instead of building it.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerFoodPolicy_Desc: Wardens no longer bring restricted food to a prisoner having a mental break. A pawn in a mental break that feeds itself behaves as in vanilla.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerBleeding_Desc: Wardens skip feeding and food delivery while a prisoner is still bleeding, so they can move on to tending. Manual feeding orders still work.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerFoodDelivery_Desc: Wardens deliver food at the same hunger level as vanilla, but one trip brings enough for everyone in the cell who needs it by then, so food does not sit in the cell and spoil. Food already in the cell is counted, and only one warden delivers to a cell at a time, so wardens do not deliver twice. If a prisoner in the cell is already urgently hungry, more wardens may deliver at once to catch up, as many as the missing food needs full trips.
LanguageData.VTU_TranslationFixes_Desc: Fixes mistakes in the official translations that a translation file cannot override (currently Traditional Chinese): quest text shown as "ERR:" with raw [tags] for mech cluster outposts, and generated text left in English (pilgrims quest, trial accusations, ideoligion stories, art descriptions).
LanguageData.VTU_XenogermQueue_Desc: Adds a bill-style queue to the gene assembler: do X times, until you have X, or forever. Skipping an entry keeps its progress.
LanguageData.VTU_DragReorder_Desc: Hold the right mouse button and drag to reorder the bottom bar, the architect categories and the buildings inside them.
LanguageData.VTU_MuteBirthSounds_Desc: Mutes the labor (early/late) and birth sounds. Other baby sounds are unchanged.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerDefaultFoodPolicy_Desc: Pawns get the food policy chosen below when they become your prisoners, so a prisoner-only policy no longer has to be set by hand for each capture. A recruited or released prisoner still on that policy goes back to the default policy. The policy is matched by name, so use the same name in every save.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerPolicyNoGame: Load a save to pick a food policy.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerPolicyMissing: This save has no food policy named "{0}"; new prisoners keep the default policy.
LanguageData.VTU_PrisonerPolicyApplied: {0} prisoners now use the food policy "{1}".
LanguageData.VTU_HybridXenotype: Hybrid children keep a matching xenotype
LanguageData.VTU_HybridXenotype_Desc: A child labeled Hybrid whose germline genes match one heritable xenotype by more than 80% (genes weighted by complexity, skin and hair color ignored) gets that xenotype instead; a tie is decided at random. Checked at birth and on every load; genes are not changed, and pawns with xenogenes are skipped unless the option below is on.
LanguageData.VTU_HybridIncludeXenogenes_Desc: Match all genes, germline and xenogenes alike, against every xenotype (heritable or not). Also covers hybrids with xenogenes and Baseliners still shown with the default faceless icon, such as pawns implanted with a xenogerm, and checks them again right after a xenogerm is implanted. Custom xenotypes given their own icon, and mutants, are left alone.
LanguageData.VTU_FactionColors_Desc: On load, if any two factions with settlements on the world map have colors that look almost the same, the close colors are nudged apart, each moving only as far as needed and keeping its own color family as much as possible. Your own faction and the Empire keep their colors, and nothing changes when no colors are too close. The new colors are saved with the game.
LanguageData.VTU_FactionColorsMinDistance_Desc: How different two faction colors must look (OKLab distance x 100). Higher values change more factions. Takes effect on the next load.
LanguageData.VTU_CompactColonistBar_Desc: Colonist bar portraits shrink to two thirds of their height and the rows move closer together while the mouse is away and expand again when the mouse moves over the bar. Collapsed portraits show the head only.
LanguageData.VTU_RemoveFogOfWar_Desc: Reveals the whole map when it is generated or loaded. Fogged areas where revealing would set something off (sleeping enemies such as ancient dangers, quest or reveal signals, entity codex or hidden item discoveries) keep their fog and play as in vanilla; the rest of the map is still revealed. Rock, ore and collapsed rocks stay hidden until they are reached by mining, and pocket maps such as the labyrinth are never revealed.
LanguageData.VTU_CaravanFactionIcon_Desc: The form caravan, reform caravan and transport pod loading lists show the faction icon of every pawn that is not from your faction, such as guests and prisoners. Hover it for the faction name, click it for the faction info card.
LanguageData.VTU_CaravanEncounterNoJump: Caravan encounters stay on the current map
LanguageData.VTU_CaravanEncounterNoJump_Desc: When an event happens to a caravan, such as meeting another caravan, a demand from a hostile one, or a mod event like finding ruins (Real Ruins), its dialog opens without switching from the colony map to the world map. Choosing to enter the encounter map still takes you there.
LanguageData.VTU_PinnedResources: Pin resources in the resource list
LanguageData.VTU_PinnedResources_Desc: In the categorized resource list (top left), left-click a resource to pin it. Pinned resources stay listed while their category is collapsed and are shown even when you have none. Double-click to unpin. Pins apply to every save.
LanguageData.VTU_PinnedResources_Pin: Click to pin: stays listed while its category is collapsed, even at 0.
LanguageData.VTU_NutrientPasteStock_Desc: Adds a "dispense until you have X" target to nutrient paste dispensers, like a cooking bill. The number is shared by every dispenser on the map. Cooks dispense paste and drop it by the dispenser for haulers, like a bill set to drop on the floor. Paste on the ground counts toward the target as well as paste in storage, so it does not pile up before haulers arrive.
LanguageData.VTU_PS_GizmoDesc: Cooks dispense nutrient paste and drop it by the dispenser until you have this many. Shared by every dispenser on this map.
LanguageData.VTU_PS_DialogNote: Counts paste in storage, being carried and on the ground (now {0}). 0 turns it off.
LanguageData.VTU_ModUpdateNotes_Desc: The main menu's top-left box (translation credits) becomes a list of your active Steam Workshop mods, most recently updated first. Mods updated since you last opened them are highlighted; click one to read its change notes from the Workshop. Works for every mod. On the first run every mod counts as read.
LanguageData.VTU_MU_Failed: Could not load the change notes. Use the button above to open the page.
LanguageData.VTU_MU_NoNotes: The Workshop change notes page has no entry for this version.
LanguageData.VTU_BreakUpFights_Desc: Anyone who sees a social fight nearby and is not hostile to either fighter (colonists, visitors, even raiders among themselves) may step in and try to stop it, unless they are busy with work that cannot be interrupted. A rival of either fighter, or anyone with Bloodlust, may instead join in against the fighter they like least. Success depends on their Social skill and on how much the fighters like them. When it fails, the fighter may turn on them, using the vanilla social fight formula, and the old opponent keeps going: a brawl that lasts until that fighter stops. Fighters remember who broke up their fight: most are grateful, but some resent it.
LanguageData.VTU_BF_JoinedIn: {PAWN1_labelShort} jumped into the fight to gang up on {PAWN2_labelShort}!
LanguageData.VTU_BF_DraggedIn: {PAWN1_labelShort} turned on {PAWN2_labelShort}, who tried to break up the fight!
LanguageData.VTU_ShortMapNames_Desc: Names under pawns on the map are cut to about one and a half cells wide (following the zoom) so long names do not cover their neighbours. The full name shows while the mouse is over the pawn or its name, or while the pawn is selected.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_AddToQueueDesc: Add this xenogerm to the assembler's queue instead of replacing the current job. Queued xenogerms start automatically one after another, like workbench bills.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_QueueGizmoDesc: View and edit the queue of xenogerms this assembler will create automatically.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_PausedHint: Queue is paused. No new xenogerm will be started until it is resumed.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_Empty: The queue is empty. Use "Add to queue" in the recombine window.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_SkipDesc: Set this xenogerm aside and start the next entry in the queue. Its progress is kept and continues when it comes up again. Inserted archite capsules are dropped next to the assembler.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_SkipNoNext: No other queue entry can be started right now.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_DeleteRunningDesc: Remove from queue. The xenogerm in progress is not cancelled.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_MissingGenepacks: Xenogerm queue: skipping {0}, some genepacks are no longer in a connected gene bank.
LanguageData.VTU_XQ_QueuePaused: Xenogerm queue paused because the current xenogerm was cancelled.
LanguageData.VTU_DR_Hint: Hold the right mouse button on a bottom bar button, an architect category, a building or a command button of the selection, drag it onto another one and release to move it there. Command buttons share one order across pawns, buildings and animals.
LanguageData.VTU_DR_ResetDesignators: Reset building order in all categories
LanguageData.VTU_CB_ShowIcons: Status icons (sleeping, idle, mental break, role...)
LanguageData.VTU_CB_ShowWeapons: Weapons (when shown under portraits in the game options)
LanguageData.VTU_CB_MagnifyHovered: Enlarge the portrait under the mouse
LanguageData.VTU_CB_MagnifyHovered_Desc: The entry under the mouse becomes a bit wider and its portrait a bit larger; the head stays in view and the feet are cut off. Clicks in the gap next to a portrait also go to that portrait.
LanguageData.VTU_CB_CustomPortraits_Desc: Makes colonist bar entries taller and moves the portrait camera closer, so each entry shows the whole pawn inside its frame. Off: vanilla size.
LanguageData.VTU_CB_PortraitsByCustomPortraits: Portrait size is controlled by [NL] Custom Portraits while it is active.
LanguageData.VTU_CB_RaceZoom: Extra zoom per race (races on the colonist bar):
